trashIntro: A deleted project is no longer on the site. It stays here for {days} days with its images: restore it in one click, after which it is erased for good (its images stay in the media library).
emptySlots: {count, plural, one {# empty slot} other {# empty slots}}
erasedIn: erased in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
emptyText: A project groups the images of a single piece of work (a film, a series, a commission).
orderNote: The order of the projects is the order on the site.
createIntro: The project is created without a name: you will name it afterwards, and adding its images is offered right away.
blockedIntro: This project is displayed by {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}: remove it from these blocks before deleting it.
deleteKeep: It leaves the site, but its images and its {slots} slots stay in the trash for {days} days: you can restore it or undo right afterwards. Its images stay in the media library.
notShown: This project does not appear on your site yet: a project is only visible if a page displays it.
pendingDrafts: {count, plural, one {One slot has} other {# slots have}} draft changes in a page's visual editor: they only appear here after “Publish” on that page.
textHeld: The texts of this project (name, context, presentation, year) are being edited in the editor of the page “{page}”: publish that page or discard its changes before changing them here.
notShownLink: Choose the page where it will appear
